# ignitify_task (Resource)

A task: the name its code is deployed and run under. Needs tasks.read and tasks.write. A destroy deletes the task with its deployments, runs and hooks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ignitify_task" "report" {
  slug = "report"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The task slug (1 to 63 lower case letters, digits and '-', starting and ending with a letter or digit). It must equal the `slug` in the task's config. A change replaces the task. The import id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the task was created (ISO 8601).
- `resource_id` (String) The public resource id of the task.
- `task_id` (String) The server id of the task.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is the task slug.
terraform import ignitify_task.report report
```
